title: Overflow Auto Eggs, Instant Steal, Auto Place & More
features:
🥚 Main
- 🚜 Auto Farm Eggs
- 🎯 Farm by egg, rarity, or mutation
- ✅ Multiple egg, rarity, and mutation selections
- 🏆 Egg priority: best luck, nearest, or fastest hatch
- 📦 Automatic egg collection and delivery
- 🪺 Auto Place Eggs
- 🐣 Auto Hatch Eggs
- 🔟 Respects the 10-egg plot limit, including space reserved for held and carried eggs
- 🔄 Resumes farming when space opens
- ♻️ Rebirth Egg Farming
- 🌋 Volcanic Egg support
- 🔥 Auto Magma Mutation with volcano routing, result checks, and return travel
- 💨 Adjustable Tween Speed
- ↕️ Adjustable Route Height
- 📏 Adjustable Farm Range
- 🧱 Wall collision handling during tween travel
- 🏡 Return to Plot

🐾 Pets
- 🏆 Auto Place Best Pets
- 💰 Auto Collect Pet Income
- 🖱️ Place Best Pets once
- 🏇 Auto Ride Best Pet
- 🍖 Auto Feed Pets
- ⭐ Feed best pet or all placed pets
- 📊 Feeding priority: income, age, or rarity
- 🥕 Food selection
- 🖱️ Feed Once

📈 Progression
- ♻️ Auto Rebirth
- 🔍 Detects the required rebirth pet and checks ownership
- 🍀 Auto Buy Hatch Luck
- 🛒 Hatch luck purchase options: Buy Max or Buy 1
- 🪺 Auto Unlock Nests on accounts using nests
- 🎁 Auto Claim Index Rewards
- 🍎 Auto Buy Food with item selection
- 🧰 Auto Buy Gear with item selection
- 📡 Auto Buy Radars
- 📡 Auto Use Radars
- ✅ Radar selection
- 💵 Keep Cash reserve
- 🔄 Selected shop items take turns purchasing when stock and cash allow

🌐 Servers
- 🔔 Discord webhook notifications
- 🔗 Discord Webhook URL input
- 🥚 Egg Found alerts
- 📦 Egg Collected alerts
- 🔥 Confirmed Magma Mutation alerts
- ♻️ Rebirth alerts
- 🎯 Egg filters for notifications
- 🧪 Send Test Notification
- 📬 Notification delivery status
- 🔁 Notification retries and rate-limit handling

👁️ Visuals
- 🥚 Egg ESP with names, rarities, and mutations
- 🐾 Pet ESP
- 👥 Pet ESP selection: your pets, other players’ pets, or both
- 📏 Adjustable ESP Distance
- 🙈 Hide all pets, your pets, or other players’ pets
- 🎭 Local name masking for yourself or all players

🧰 Misc
- ⚡ Instant Interact
- 💤 Anti-AFK
- 🌍 Adjustable Gravity
- 🛠️ Load Infinite Yield
- 👻 Noclip
- 🦘 Infinite Jump
- 🪽 Fly
- 🏃 Adjustable Walk Speed
- ⬆️ Adjustable Jump Power or Jump Height
- 📐 Adjustable Hip Height
- 🖥️ No Rendering
- 🎞️ Adjustable FPS Cap
- 🌐 Server Hop
- 👥 Join Small Server
- 🔄 Rejoin
